race.comment: THE AUTUMN WIND (8) made a big impression on debut when winning a Maiden at this track and distance on soft ground as an odds-on favourite after travelling well and lengthening strongly. He now has to take that into BM58 company, but the profile is progressive and the same track-and-trip setup gives him the clearest winning case. KERMITISAPET (4) brings sharper race fitness after sweeping home to win a Class 1 at the Beaumont by just over three lengths, with her wet-track record and proven 1200m form adding substance. Leading contender. OVERZONE (2) resumes off a six-month break with a Muswellbrook trial behind him. Consistent gelding likely to go back from the draw and be ridden for luck. THE DUX NUTS (15) is third-up, well drawn and has the 1200m record to be dangerous, especially if he builds on the close Class 1 fifth at Tamworth two runs back. Leading player.
